name: Auras Trading
desc:
How to play ? 😎
Stand on the board with the one you want to trade😁
Drop the auras on the board 🤑
Jump on the green button if you want to confirm✅ 
Wanna get more auras? Use the blue button🐋➕
If decline, jump on the red button❌💃🏽

Cool auras are waiting for you, just have fun !!!
